content: Bampughulu buolo
Oŋo, bágwi me libaŋana li lili ti anga elyimi kii otagha bula ya bályele kundaa me ti: Gye ya tagha ebini kii ngili, ebini ki baakagwa mikaba ya tala baara ba baakasamana omo.
Lo ka tagha mbala a nzo a Nzaami o, nyaã yo, mu kuulu baagwi yo kundaa bikaana. Me bikaana bibye akala biidzyara bvulu lili ngili mu bangoono makwumu-mana ya buolo (42).
Me sa ngwa muswa kundaa bampughulu ba me buolo mu obighili, bu balaha binkuru bibi bupfiili, mu bitsughu pfwunu ya nkama ywolo, ya makwumu masemene (1 260)
Bampughulu bwolo babo me miti mi-Olibve myele ya bilogho bi baakatwulu miindi byele bi bili ŋa nkulu a Mfumu a nsie.
Kala ti mbwuru dzyi osa bo bubi, lo mbaa yipala mu miŋma mi bo ya yitsughu mitaara mi bo. Eẽ, kala ti mbwuru dzyi osa bo bubi, ali bubwe nde akpa obo.
Bo bali a litumu lili okuru mvulu mu matala ma baasala bo esala kii mibighili. Ya bo bali a litumu lii okirili madza makili ya lii ogwa nsie biwa bibi mawa-mawa, nswe matala ma badzyi bo.
Lo mu matala ma akala baamana bo osuo bumpughulu bu bo, nyama wu a nkehe wu aapala kunsa mbie yi nda ya nsihi sa adzwana a bo, sa alughulu ŋa nkulu a bo ya sa adzwa bo.
Bibyimi bi bo sa bikala ŋa munsagha wu munene mu bvulu li linene mu bákomo Mfumu a bo ŋa kuruwa. Bvulu lilo bákata lo mu efaana kii bvulu lili Sodome ya nsie yi a Edzipite.
Baara baba bikaana byehene, bitswumu byehene, mandiŋi mwohono ya mansie, sa bamono bibyimi bi bo mu bitsughu bitere ya ndaama, ya ka bagwa muswa ti badzyighi bibyimi bibye o.
Baara ba nsie sa bakala kunsa esee mu nkooro a lipfu li bo, sa basa kyiri ya sa bagweghe bo-a-bo bimbwaã, mu kuulu mibighili minsa myele mimye míkamwehẽ bo kimini.
Lo ŋa mbihi a bitsughu bitere ya ndaama bibye, mufulu wu a bumweẽ wu áafi kundaa Nzaami ásomo mu bo ya bo bátemene. Ba bákamono bo bábagha nzalamweẽ yi alagha.
Mibighili myele mimye mígyughu likyi li linene li lílyele kundaa bo ti: Liyakumu ŋa. Bo bákumu ku yulu kunsa edzi ŋa mihi mi mitaara mi bo.

Mu tala lyini lilo, nsie yínyiĩ mu mpini, kaba limõ mu makaba kwumu ma bvulu líbwi, ya baara mapfwunu nsaama (7 000) bápki mu munyiĩ a nsie munde. Baara bana bábagha nzalamweẽ ya bágwi Nzaami wu a mu mayulu nsia.
Mpara yi a gyolo yiiluru. Mpara yi matere yili mu ogya edzi-dzighi.
Mvulu-a-mvulu yi a nsaama
Mu obo, ngye-yulu wu a nsaama áfulu mvulu-a-mvulu. Nkyi yi a mpini yídzumu mu yulu yíkalyele ti:

content.text: Empu e nsie eeluru kundaa Mfumu a bihi ya kundaa Kriste a nde.
Nde sa atumu mu mibvu ya mibvu!

content: Bakwuru makwumu-muolo ya bana (24) ba bábwi-nsini ŋa nkulu a Nzaami ŋa yulu a makubu ma bo bábwi mapfumunu, bákunu mabuo ŋa nsie ŋa nkulu a Nzaami,
bákalyele ti:

content.text: Mfumu Nzaami Nga-a-mpwũ, bihi libvurulu we matuono,
we wu li ya wu áli,
mu kuulu we aasalala lileene li we li linene,
ya we aabwihi empu e we nsini.
lo nkehe yi a ndaa we yiigyi,
ya matala mama olamana ba bákpi,
mu ogwa mufuru kundaa basala ba we mibighili,
ba bangili ya ba baakagwa nkwumu a we budziri,

content: Bádzubulu nzo a Nzaami yi li mu mayulu ya nkobo yi endughu e nde yímoŋono omo. Mu matala maana mamo óli a misehene, nkyi, banganzele, minyiĩ mi nsie ya mvulu wu makele wu a mpini.
